SELECT ROUND(start_lon, 3) AS startLon, ROUND(start_lat, 3) AS startLat, ROUND(end_lon, 3) AS endLon, ROUND(end_lat, 3) AS endLat, COUNT(*) AS weight FROM dwd_taxi_trip WHERE start_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY startLon, startLat, endLon, endLat
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
SELECT ROUND(end_lon, 3) AS lon, ROUND(end_lat, 3) AS lat, COUNT(*) AS intensity FROM dwd_taxi_trip WHERE end_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY lon, lat ORDER BY intensity DESC
